title: Review gate
description: A coder implements the input on its own branch, make test checks it, a reviewer reviews it, and the branch is squashed into the main checkout's branch as one commit.

nodes.prompt: Implement the task in this worktree, on branch graph/{{run}}, with tests for what you change. Commit everything with conventional-commit messages (type(scope): summary); the first commit's subject becomes the squashed commit's subject, so make it describe the whole change. Leave nothing uncommitted. Never merge, rebase onto or push the main branch yourself: when you end your turn, make test runs in this worktree, then a reviewer reads the branch, and once it approves Clubmate squashes the branch into the main checkout. Task: {{input}}

Review branch graph/{{run}}, written by session {{node.coder}} for this task: {{input}}. Compare it with the branch checked out in the repo's main checkout (the first entry of git worktree list), e.g. git diff <that branch>...graph/{{run}}. make test already passed on it. Look for bugs, missing or weakened tests (an edited test that now passes for the wrong reason counts), changes the task did not ask for, and commit subjects that misdescribe the change. Do not edit code. Report approved when the branch can be squashed as it is; otherwise report changes and list each needed change in your reply.

edges.text: The reviewer asks for changes: read its last reply with agents_transcript {"session":"{{node.reviewer}}"}, make them and commit.
